hypothesis: Adding the 4 causal zigzag-state features (zz_trend_state, zz_bars_since_pivot, zz_move_from_pivot_pct, zz_dist_to_threshold) as plain model inputs to the causalfix_final triple-barrier entry classifier, evaluated with purge+embargo+uniqueness weighting and N=5 genuinely random seeds, changes the entry model's OOS gross edge relative to a hygiene-matched control trained on causalfix_final alone.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: Raw zigzag-feature injection into the TB entry input was already tried and reported to 'hurt backtest PnL' (comment in scripts/train_btc_regime_curriculum_meta_transformer_20260807.py, citing scripts/build_btc_5m_zigzag_state_causal_features_20260806.py), but no artifact, seed count, or hygiene setting is recorded for that run, and it necessarily predates gate G2 (2026-08-07), which discovered that this exact label has effective_n ~4,058 (not 43,798 nominal) and that single/few-seed evaluation on it is unreliable (0/12 seeds OOS-positive despite the shipped single seed looking profitable). The prior verdict was very likely reached without purge, without uniqueness weighting, and on 1 seed -- the same conditions G2 showed cannot be trusted on this label.
research.retest_design: Paired comparison, same 5 genuinely random (non-clustered) seeds run twice: (A) causalfix_final only, (B) causalfix_final + the 4 zz_ features, both under G2's D_purge_uniq hygiene (purge=True, embargo_bars=288, uniqueness_weights=True) and otherwise-identical architecture/training config. Compare seed-mean OOS gross edge (bps) and t-stat between A and B, and both against the G0' always_short reference (+2.72bps OOS, 3-seed A_repro-equivalent hygiene). This isolates the single variable (feature presence) the prior informal test did not control for.

model.candidate_architecture: transformer_window48_d96_l3_dropout025 (frozen to G2's D_purge_uniq config, only feature set varies)

selection.validation_pass_criteria: seed-mean OOS gross edge (bps) significantly (t>=2) above the always_short baseline, condition B vs condition A
